netbirdio/netbird.changelog:
# Release Notes for v0.82.0

## Highlights

### 🛣️ Latency-aware HA routing that holds stable routes

Routing peers in an HA group with equal metrics are meant to be chosen by latency, but the client used to sample latency only once, when the connection was set up, and moved the route on events that did not need it. Every switch between masquerading routing peers resets the TCP connections using the route, so SSH sessions and other long-lived flows dropped more often than they had to.

The client now samples the latency of connected routing peers continuously and smooths it, and moves…

penpot/penpot.changelog:
### :boom: Breaking changes & Deprecations

#### Migrate legacy file payloads to file_data and delete orphan revisions

File payloads now live in one place: every file state and snapshot is kept in `file_data`, and the orphan `file_change` rows that kept old payloads alive forever are removed. No read path reached those rows and nothing ever collected them, so the upgrade also reclaims the database and TOAST space they held. There is no API or UI change.
